text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Ben Ali chaired a cabinet meeting on the role of the private sector in higher education.
- President Ben Ali congratulates the new British Prime Minister Tony Blair.
- Tunisia elected as member of the Human Rights Committee of the United Nations.
- The German state-run agency of technical cooperation GTZ to open a bureau in Tunis.
- Tunisian employers' organisation UTICA and Argentinian chamber of commerce sign in Tunis an accord to boost cooperation in trade and investment.
